# EnerSys Announces Participation in the Oppenheimer 20th Annual Industrial Growth Conference on May 8, 2025


### READING, Pa., Apr. 24, 2025 (BUSINESS WIRE) -


EnerSys (NYSE: ENS) a global leader in stored energy solutions for industrial applications announced today that President & Chief Operating Officer, Shawn O’Connell, and EVP & Chief Financial Officer, Andrea Funk, are scheduled to present on Thursday, May 8th, at the Oppenheimer 20th Annual Industrial Growth Conference, being held in a virtual format.


The presentation will begin at 10:30 a.m. ET. A live webcast and archived replay will be available at[https://wsw.com/webcast/oppenheimer41/ens/2552550](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwsw.com%2Fwebcast%2Foppenheimer41%2Fens%2F2552550&esheet=54241140&newsitemid=20250424128646&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwsw.com%2Fwebcast%2Foppenheimer41%2Fens%2F2552550&index=2&md5=9c4aad6eb38b104ad5886d4b1a00627f) .
